findings.issue: שֶׂה (common gender, singular) is one flock animal, sheep or goat, with no age marked; cordero narrows it to a young male sheep.
Pual imperfect is rendered as present es primogenitado; the other imperfect in the verse is future.
Affirmation particle אַךְ is taken as restrictive Solo.

notes: Other tokens keep number, person, pual/hiphil, אתו, repeated אם, and both ליהוה; the final clause stays verbless.
